# quiv

> quiv is a one-machine, threadpool-backed background scheduler for Python apps (built for FastAPI) — recurring and one-shot tasks, sync and async handlers, cooperative cancellation via an injected `stop_event`, progress callbacks dispatched to the main asyncio loop via `progress_hook`, per-job trace IDs via `job_id`, and an optional process pool (`executor="process"`: one spawned process per job, which quiv can terminate). Python 3.10–3.14, MIT licensed.

Key facts for working with quiv:

- Positioning: more than FastAPI `BackgroundTasks`, less than Celery. Not for workers on other machines, durable queues, or cron/calendar scheduling.
- A process job (`executor="process"`) needs a handler importable by name (module-level function or staticmethod); a stop signal it ignores for `process_kill_grace` seconds terminates its process.
- Task/job state lives in a temporary SQLite file deleted on `shutdown()` — nothing persists across restarts.
- `add_task()` returns a `task_id` (UUID string) that keys all runtime operations; `task_name` is a non-unique display label.
- `job_id`, `stop_event`, and `progress_hook` are injected only if the handler signature declares them.
- Cancellation is cooperative: handlers must check `stop_event.is_set()`.
- An agent-oriented condensed guide ships inside the installed package at `quiv/AGENTS.md` (in site-packages).
- A full-text concatenation of these docs is at https://nandyalu.github.io/quiv/llms-full.txt

## Docs

- [Home / overview](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nandyalu/quiv/main/docs/index.md): what quiv is, quick FastAPI example, caveats
- [Getting Started](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nandyalu/quiv/main/docs/getting-started.md): install, scheduler setup, first task, FastAPI lifespan integration, logging, troubleshooting
- [API reference](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nandyalu/quiv/main/docs/api.md): `Quiv` constructor, `add_task`, task/job operations, waiting for a job (`wait_for_job`/`await_job`, `wait_for_task`/`await_task`), `run_on_main`, `call_on_main`, `run_subprocess`, models (`Executor`, `Task.executor`, `Job.pid`), events, `QuivConfig`, pool sizing
- [Bigger Applications](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nandyalu/quiv/main/docs/bigger-applications.md): structuring quiv in multi-module apps
- [Running in a Container](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nandyalu/quiv/main/docs/containers.md): `shutdown(timeout=...)` inside the stop grace period, the temporary database and `TMPDIR`, logging, re-adding tasks at restart, a daily run at a set time, a health check with `is_running`, one scheduler per process
- [Architecture](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nandyalu/quiv/main/docs/architecture.md): scheduler / persistence / execution layer design
- [Progress Callbacks](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nandyalu/quiv/main/docs/progress-callbacks.md): `progress_hook` and main-loop dispatch
- [Run on Main Loop](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nandyalu/quiv/main/docs/run-on-main.md): `run_on_main` helper — dispatch to the main loop from anywhere; `call_on_main`, the sibling that waits for the result and lets the job span the work; why quiv never waits for or cancels fire-and-forget work, and `pending_main_loop_work()`
- [Event Listeners](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nandyalu/quiv/main/docs/event-listeners.md): task/job lifecycle events and typed callbacks
- [Cancellation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nandyalu/quiv/main/docs/cancellation.md): cooperative cancellation with `stop_event`; `run_subprocess` for a child process a cancel can stop; `JobCancelledError` from the helpers
- [Process Jobs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nandyalu/quiv/main/docs/process-jobs.md): `executor="process"`, `process_pool_size`, `process_kill_grace`; what a handler may be; what crosses the pipe; the kill rule; the outcomes; the inert scheduler in the child; the spawn cost
- [Failure Handling](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nandyalu/quiv/main/docs/failure-handling.md): per-task cooperative timeouts, retry with exponential backoff, jitter
- [Observability](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nandyalu/quiv/main/docs/observability.md): `stats()` snapshot, filtered/paginated job and task queries, `pending_main_loop_work()`, admin endpoints
- [Exceptions](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nandyalu/quiv/main/docs/exceptions.md): the `QuivError` hierarchy
- [Testing](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nandyalu/quiv/main/docs/testing.md): testing your own handlers against a real scheduler with `wait_for_task`; what quiv's own suite covers
